avis.texte: I'm a 55 year old black woman with dark skin and I use this at night. You can feel the Hyaluronic stinging a little so if that bother you skip days. However, it has really help to improve my skin complexion and helped with the fine lines
A worker recommended this and I love it! It has already worked on my face in just two weeks! I can tell a difference and will definitely continue to use this.
I have been using this product every day for about 2 years. Can't go without.

I tried another treatment because this is a bit pricey but I came back. I love the tingling that I feel from the Vitamin C. Not sure if that means there is more concentrate than compeditors🤷‍♀️. Goes on easy and smooth and I don't need to use a lot.

avis.titre: It's almost like magic in a bottle!
avis.texte: Without a doubt Kiehl's Vitamin C Serum is the very best. My skin is smoother and brighter in a way that almost seemed unreal. I honestly wondered if I was imagining the difference being so noticeable until I visited family I'd not seen in a few years. I was actually asked if I had had work done. That visit ended with two family members buying Kiehl's Vitamin C Serum! My skin looks better than it did when I was in my 30's! I love this serum so much!
Repeated use has cleared my skin and made my coloring more even. I have a healthy glow.
This product has been great. I have very sensitive skin and this has not caused any irritation!
Love the product, has a nice creamy feel to it. Best part, it worked well under my make up.
I've been using the vitamin C serum for three months. My skin is smooth and bright with a beautiful glow; I look younger.

avis.titre: Burning and itching sensation after applying
avis.texte: This is a very bad product, it has the texture of cream which feels like broken glass and there is a lot of itching and burning sensation when applied. Don't buy it

I used it for 2 days and after the first day I saw an extra wrinkle under my L eye and a weird texture near the orbital bone, but I thought that I slept wrong or something. The next day in the morning I saw that it was still weird and it started to get a little bit itchy. That night I decided to try it one more time to see if it got worse or not. On the third day I saw it a little bit red, but when I placed my usual eye cream it burned, meaning it was definitely damaging something and there was a patch under the eye with a weird rougher texture. went to ulta to return it. Never again. I use other products from this brand and nothing has even happened. This one is not for me.
The vitamin C serum goes on smooth and not sticky at all. I use it first in AM & PM before other products. I can tell a difference in my skin after just a week.
This stuff is crazy powerful. I saw results within a week. Does this mean I have to use it forever? What happens if I miss a couple days by accident?

I LOVE this product and have been a loyal buyer for years. It is a great deal for the price, and last a long time. I've seen results - skin brightening, redness reduction after consistent, daily use. I sometimes find Vitamin C Serums to be sticky, and I am also prone to spilling them. This product is not sticky, and does not leave my skin feeling heavy or oily. Also, it's spill proof. LOVE.LOVE.LOVE.
Takes a bit of time for results to show, but really effective in lightening dark circles

avis.titre: Kiehl's Powerful Strength Vitamin C Serum!!
avis.texte: I have dry, sensitive skin and have always been wary of vitamin C serums. But Kiehl's Powerful Strength Vitamin C Serum changed everything. It's gentle, hydrating, and actually delivers results. The blend of vitamin C and hyaluronic acid leaves my skin bright, plump, and radiant. Plus, its stable formula ensures potency without irritation. And as a bonus, it works as a fantastic primer before makeup. If you struggle with sensitive skin like me, this serum is a must-try.
Love this product so much; I wear it daily. It makes my skin feel amazing - hydrated, silky, etc.
I can't believe how much I love this. In addition to an amazing glow this stuff got rid of my eye milia!
Love this texture. Feel warm. I don't know how it works yet though believe my skin will be better.
I absolutely love this product. It has truly helped reduce the line in my forehead. I use this every single day

I LOVE this formula. You're expecting a thin serum, and it's instead a thick but quickly absorbing silky, creamy lotion. It goes on beautifully and a little goes a long way. It definitely is helping to relax fine lines, especially when used with the Vitamin C eye formula. It's so comforting to my easily irritated skin, yet powerful enough for visible results. Also has a pleasant, mild scent.

This is one of the few skincare products I've used where I saw a noticeable difference in my skin. It's helped fade some hyperpigmentation from past acne and made my forehead lines more shallow and less noticeable. Best product!

This stuff is amazing. I use this every morning before my moisturizer and have been for years. The little tingle tells me that it's working. This in the morning and the retinal at night, along with the cloud and I get compliments on my skin all the time.
Visible change in skin appearance after a few days of continuous wear
I massage this cream around my mouth to soften the tiny lines. It is excellent & I have recommended it to alot of people. I was surprised at the quick results.
I have used this serum for years. I use it at night. It makes my face feel moisturized and it has really helped my wrinkles.

Worked ok with somewhat noticeable results. However after a couple months I realized it was responsible for the yellow stains that had developed on my pillow cases and the necks on my dress shirts! They won't come out so have now lost 2 sets of sheets and 6-8 shirts.
Kiehl's is the only stuff i use. This serum makes the wrinkles and lines stay away. It really does.

avis.titre: Was hoping to see some results
avis.texte: I didn't see results from using the product for a month, unfortunately. Used it daily and was hoping for more!

What I like about most about this is that is an airless pump! I feel like all vitamin C should be packaged like this due to how unstable of an ingredient it is. I've been using it about 2 months and so far so good. Not a drastic change yet but I will keep going. It does tingle when putting it on, so I guess if you're sensitive start slow, maybe 1-2 a week and work up from there!

I can't live without this serum! Visiably reduces fine lines after consistent use. Best to pair this with the SPF cream since they work best together. I love how this brightens and tightens my skin. I like the quick absorbing lotion vs the silky serum for this particular product!
I love the smooth, spreadable consistency. It doesn't leave a sticky residue. I use this in the morning after cleansing and toning. I appreciate how gentle it is.
The plastic bottle seems problematic. It made the product yellow, which I guess resulted from the vitamin C reacting with the brown dye in plastic?

avis.titre: I was confused with the color of the cream!
avis.texte: It was my first time using this product. Ordered this back in september last year. It was color yellowish and I thought its the real color and just keep using it. I ordered this again in Dec bc it was on sale and I open it and the cream is color white! So the one I got in September was expired? My face didn't damage or anything. I guess it's just ddnt work well. 🤣
I had an age spot appear on my chest. This took care of the new spot and faded the older spots. The new age spot totally disappeared.
great. Very nice texture. easy to used. I will buy it for sure next time
Love this stuff. My skin feels so smooth and soft after using it, I use it every day.

avis.titre: Incredible product – great results, great field
avis.texte: This product came highly recommended to me for good reason. Of course the results are what we are all looking for but in addition to great results this product is so wonderful to put on as it has warm creamy feel to it. Highly recommend!
Brightens and smooth skin, this has a very slight tingle when applied, and adds an extra sparkle!

I like this product, but I am confused. I have been using this for a couple of years now and in the past it has been an orange/yellow tint. I just opened a bottle and it's a white cream. Did the formula change? Old?

I received samples of this product with other purchases. The first time I used it I was in Chicago in the winter. It was magnificent. It saved my skin from the freezing temperatures and I was sold. The I tried it in North Carolina in the summer. Not so much a fan. The cream soured on my skin. I solved this problem by using it at night before bedtime. I wake up with smooth, soft skin with many of the problems that plague my skin for decades gone. I strongly recommend this product.

I have been a happy user for years. The first few times I used it, my face tingled and I was afraid it would be a bad reaction. Fortunately, that was not the case. I have seen the difference whenever I used it regularly. My skin instantly looks radiant and feels supple. Kiehls unfortunately has a tendency to discontinue products that works for the majority of users and that irritates me. Let's hope this will not be one of those products like my cactus hydrating mist they foolishly discontinued.
I can feel it working. Does firm up skin and help smooth creases and wrinkles. It doesn't make them go away but improves my face and neck skin.

First, I would like to say that this 12% Vitamin C concentration is by far from all the other Vitamin C products. Because the base is like cream and included hyaluronic acid, so I use it as the treatment and moisturizer just behind the toner and serum steps. Great value and saving time for applying, great results after 3 months. My skin looks lighter, the fine lines are reducing visibly.
This vitamin C serum definitely make the skin smooth, uiniform, and lessens the wrinkles. I also think its lightening the dark spots….time will tell

avis.titre: Love this stuff! Pricey but worth it
avis.texte: This has made my skin feel so much better. My skin has been acting up this year from dryness to wrinkles. It helps plump me up and getting my skin back to normal. I was using it twice a day but that was too much for my sensitive skin. Once a day at night time works perfect. Will continue using it!

Kiehl's Powerful-Strength Vitamin C Serum has brightened my skin up tremendously. I've used this product for over a year and it has kept my skin glowing. This product along with a few other skin care products (and sun protection) helps slow down pre-mature signs of aging. I can't help but smile when I look in the mirror and see how bright and smooth my face looks. Thank you Kiehl's!

This was my first purchase in 2024 and after a month of using it, I'm ready to say that this is my favorite vitamin C serum! And u know that i have tried many of them. It is probably half the price of another vitamin C popular serum, but probably still more expensive than some budget friendly alternatives. I use a vitamin C serum daily and this one feels amazing on my skin. It looks like a smoothing and blurring lotion that improves the appearance of my skin. It works well under sunscreen, makeup primer or foundation If you are interested in finding more honest reviews of various beauty products, please visit my instagram LetMeRecommendYou

This has been my daily serum since 2010, and it's worked with a myriad of sunscreens, bb creams, and liquid foundations. I've occasionally used it at nighttime, and even though the formula has changed over time it's been my secret weapon to combat free radicals, aging, sun spots, and wrinkles. I turn 46 next month, still smoke cigarettes, and I don't have any wrinkles or lines on my face and really feel I owe it to consistently using thus vitamin C serum.

This serum is awesome!!! Not only does it keep my skin soft, it has gradually removed my age spots, reduced the size of my pores, and reduced the fine lines on my face. I have been using this serum for over a year and do not plan to stop. Keep up the great work Kiehl's!!! Thank you.
Enjoyable refreshing serum that feels brightening to the skin
I use this I product every other night followed by the Kiehl leave on moisture mask. It as brightened my skin, and improved the appearance of fine lines.
I love the way this serum feels on my skin, and after three weeks, i am seeing a lightning of my dark spots.

avis.titre: Highly Recommend as your Vit C routine
avis.texte: I love the silky smoothness and results of this serum. Even though it already has hyaluronic acid, I add a little more hyaluronic acid and wear them together overnight. I feel it really diminishes fine lines and evens out my skin tone. I recommend this as part of your vitamin C routine daily.
I tried to contact for 1 of missing item on my last order 2 times but it has not been sent yet??

avis.titre: Better than the others- Vitamin C
avis.texte: Potent Vitamin C serum. This one worked better than the others I've tried. Dark spots have faded and my skin looks vibrant. The consistency is thicker and layers well under my other creams.
I have been using this product now for two years. It is really beneficial in eliminating lines and giving your skin a healthy, youthful appearance.
love this product. when i apply it, its so smooth and sets so well.
I love the texture. It's creamy and feels like a wonderful addition to my vitamin C routine.

I have used this product for two years now. Kiels changed the formula. It was yellow, now it's white. It's less thick and doesn't tingle when you put it in. I am so disappointed. I love the old formula! Why mess with a hood thing?
Love the ungreasy feel of this serum. Feels as if it softened and smoothed the wrinkles on my forehead. Started using a week ago, time and patience will show results.

I'd heard great things about this product, but when I used it it had a dry, pebbly consistency and after I tried to apply makeup over it, the lotion kind of clumped and created white specs that I couldn't brush offm except by washing my face.

Great product and I noticed a diference on my skin right away! It does feel a little tingle when you apply but it goes away in seconds. Definitely will keep getting more of this product. First time trying Kiehl's products. Did not dissapoint!

avis.titre: As the label states, it's Powerful!
avis.texte: Really Powerful! Enjoy the smoothing effects and the fine lines around my eyes greatly diminished. I can see the difference within a week.

avis.titre: I can use this for my Rosacea skin
avis.texte: I have stage 2 Rosacea. My face can be very sensitive sometime. This is the only Vitamin C that would not stain & burn my face. I also see good result with it. However, it has slight tingling sensation when I apply & cause minor dry & irritation when i use it more than 5 days.
I have been using this product for over a decade. It smooths any fine lines around the eyes and on the skin. I love it!

avis.titre: So far the best one that I have used
avis.texte: Really works for me , reduce lines and wrinkles, makes the skin smoother,
One of the few products I can actually see a difference after using. My skin looks smoother and tighter

Unfortunately, after using this product, the skin on my face became so dry that it began to peel. I could not figure out what was causing this, until I stopped using this cream. My skin is still peeling months later, specifically on my nose and T zone. I now need to go to a dermatologist to fix this issue because nothing is working. I'm sure this product works for others, but I wish I never bought it.
This is an excellent product, love it since day one. I use it along the Vit. C serum for the eye area every day!

avis.titre: The one product I never go without
avis.texte: I love this product. It is part of my everyday morning routine. It feels great under makeup and on my skin. I have tried other brands of Vitamin C Serum and none of them have been as good at his one. It is the one product I never go without.

This was described as 50% for the cyber deal but it turns out the two larger sizes aren't available. I like this product but I don't appreciate the false advertising. I feel like I was lured in to buy a smaller size at higher price. Do better, Kiehl's.

avis.titre: Not the same product I purchased before
avis.texte: very disappointed with my online purchase. Not only it costs much less now than when i bought it a week ago, but usually this vitamin C serum is yellow, creamier and the results were evident immediately, now it's watery and white, I do not feel the reaction of a slight burning sensation when I use it. Not sure if they changed this product or if I got a bad batch. Too bad, I have used it for over a year and I was very pleased with the results.I will return it.
Great to use in the morning after shower and also shaving. I use it under my moisturizer. Face feels great throughout the day. Highly recommend

avis.titre: Not what it used to be - very disappointing
avis.texte: I loved this product before when it was just C vitamin serum without the hyaluronic acid added. It was so efficient and made my skin soft and wrinkle-free. Now the serum just burns my face and does nothing. Very disappointed 😞
I gave this a a gift to a daughter who called me after a week and said she could already see an improvement to her facial skin.
Works well under makeup, Feels great on skin. Just what I was looking for in a vitamin C serum.
I also found my latest bottle was grainy and burns a little. My first bottle did not have this problem.

This was very effective but it dyed the hair at my temples from silver to yellow, no matter how I tried to keep it away from my hairline. I finally had to stop using it. The hair is permanently discolored. I'm just waiting for it to grow out.

avis.titre: Dried out the skin under my eyes and created lines
avis.texte: Drying, and line-producing product. Within 10 minutes the cream became stiff, the skin dried out under my eyes and lines appeared. This product seems to have replaced the extraordinary 'Powerful-Strength Line-Reducing Concentrate', your BEST product. This is a tragic mistake.
Seems to be working. Too soon to tell. I use this in the morning and retinol at night

avis.titre: Feels grainy and burns face a little
avis.texte: I returned this as it felt grainy and burned my face a little.
I have been using this product for years and really love it! Definitely helps with brightening and fine lines
Botox in lotion form. Smooths out wrinkles like no other product

avis.titre: Only VC serum that I can keep using
avis.texte: It's a pretty potent VC serum and makes my skin soft and glowy. Unlike other active vc serum I've used, it has a matte finish and not overly oily with a strong weird smell. It still gives me a tiny sting and hotness when contacting the face, but not too annoying to use.

avis.titre: Too Early to Tell but Encouraging Signs
avis.texte: I have not used this product long enough to see radical improvements of dark sun spots. Overall my skin appears mor clear and even.
Love it! Feels like silk going on! Saw a difference in skin tone!
Stings a little at first but then wanes. Good results. Have used for years.
Great product! I use this 3 times a week and it makes my skin silky smooth

avis.titre: Truly a skincare product that does as promised!
avis.texte: I love this product and think it's the very best among many other brands I've tried over the years. For me, it works as promised to reduce fine lines and imply the appearance of my skin. Honestly, overall, Kiehl's serum is my favorite skin product. If I only bought one skincare product, this would be it!
Really works! But it does take a few months to see the difference. Also, consider this a lotion vs a serum
Does a pretty good job of decreasing appearance of fine lines

I don't think of this as a serum, it's more of a cream texture. It's to thick and had a gritty texture to it . It also piles up when I layer it which makes. My skin feels dirty. So disappointed in this one.
This lightweight layer has undoubtedly improved my skin's appearance and texture.
I was expecting this to be much lighter, it feels thick and heavy. While I am not going to waste it I will look for something that makes me feel more refreshed than weighed down.

I loved the soft, buttery feel of this serum. It makes my skin feel very smooth and is not irritating to my very sensitive skin. My dermatologist recommended it to me - the Vitamin C is apparently very helpful for aging skin!
I'd love to love it but can't use anything with hyleraunic acid. Literally burns my skin. Please offer precision eye lifting serum again!
My aging skin looks much brighter and more even since switching to this vitamin C serum.
This vitamin C helped me to even my skin tone and remove dark spots on my face it a great vitamin for face and I use it with kiehls sunscreen and they're great together.

I like to combo of Vitamin C and hyaluronic acid and I use this serum in the morning under the SPF ultra facial cream. The only thing I don't like is that if feels greasy on my face, even when I only use 1 pump.

I love this product!!! The consistency is perfect and glides on my skin really nice. I have used for a month now and have noticed my skin already appears smoother and overall just looks healthier. Great product Kiehls!!!
I love this product and I can already see a difference in my skin....I reccomend it.
I never let myself run out of this great product because consistent use over the last few years has helped my almost 76 year old skin resist fine lines and wrinkles.
I have had great results with this serum. The overall feel and appearance of my skin has improved with this product.

My first time using this product. Before i purchased it, i went to the store and checked that the color of this product is white. Then i went to purchased it and it is orange! It has a slight smell to it and i'm afraid to use this product because it's probably expired. Very very disappointed.
I love this serum and have seen dramatic results since I began using it.
Th product works, but I don't like the formulation. It doesn't apply smoothly and feels like I'm pulling my skin when I try to work the product in.
